name: authoring.pr6-comparison
floor_reason: Non-gating PR6 comparison corpus. Use --no-gate; the floor is not derived from measured runs.
notes: The first 12 cases are byte-preserving task/oracle copies from authoring.primary.json v3. The five heldout-* cases are a separate transfer panel with deterministic fixture-backed result oracles. Do not change task text, fixture payloads, or oracle assertions after freeze. Fixtures are evaluator-only and are never included in the author-generator prompt.

cases.task: Call program_runtime.bindings.list() and print a small object with the key rows set to the handle count.
Use gather with three zero-argument calls to program_runtime.bindings.list(), preserve all returned handles, and print the number of handles (a number greater than one).
Call program_runtime.bindings.list(), group the rows by scenario, and print the total grouped count using group_by(...).count() without materializing the rows.
Read program_runtime.bindings.list() twice, join the two bounded handles on the id field, and print joined.count().
Classify a small list of two strings with ai.classify(source=[...], labels=["bug", "feature"]), then print the handle metadata so the governed role is visible.
Discover the capability for read test run verdicts in fast mode, inspect its first row, and print the selected binding_id when one is returned.
cases.notes: Exercises the discovery null-verdict stop rule.

cases.task: Ask fast discovery about the intentionally nonsensical capability transmute lead into gold; print no capability when binding_id is empty and never invoke a guessed binding.
Call search_hub.query.query(query="retention") without a rows= projection and let its governed ambiguous-response failure surface.
cases.notes: Exercises caller-side rows selection and fail-closed behavior.

cases.task: Attempt git_control_tower.worktree.prune() without an explicit grant and let the governed refused_no_grant failure surface.
Reuse the value named prior_result from the setup submission in the same session and print prior_result["value"].
Call vrooli.scenario.status(name="program-runtime") and print the returned row's scenario field.
Call describe(binding_id="test-genie/runs/list"); it returns argument rows, so print the first row's name field.

Query Search Hub for "program runtime" with rows="ranked". Keep only hits whose score is positive, then print one JSON object with retained_count and first_provider_id. Keep the output bounded and do not print the full result set.
cases.notes: Level 1. Owner source: packages/proto/schemas/search-hub/v1/routing/routing.proto QueryResponse.ranked/SearchHit.score/provider_id; exercised by Search Hub setpoint-read. The fixture makes filtering and the selected projection deterministic.

cases.task: Inspect the promoted library catalog, then call the exact program-runtime.handle-shaping entry with no arguments. Print one bounded JSON summary with its returned status and the signals top rows (at most three), paid_total, and paid_count. Do not assume declared_inputs are callable parameters.
cases.notes: Level 2. Owner source: scenarios/program-runtime/.vrooli/program-runtime/handle-shaping.py and handle-shaping.json. Its local fixture is deterministic, uses no bindings or inference, and has paid_total=73 and paid_count=3.

cases.task: Call agent_manager.effort.board(page_size=8, rows="rows") exactly once and print a compact JSON result. For a healthy empty page, report status "ok", coverage "complete", and selected_count 0. For an unavailable owner read or malformed row, preserve a non-success status and error, and omit selected_count instead of treating it as zero.
cases.notes: Level 3, healthy-empty arm. The owner contract and supervision-observation-read source distinguish a complete empty board page from an unavailable read.

cases.task: Call agent_manager.effort.board(page_size=8, rows="rows") exactly once and print a compact JSON result. For a healthy empty page, report status "ok", coverage "complete", and selected_count 0. For an unavailable owner read or malformed row, preserve a non-success status and error, and omit selected_count instead of treating it as zero.
cases.notes: Level 4, unavailable arm. The owner error is deterministic; the oracle checks error preservation without depending on diagnostic wording.

cases.task: Call agent_manager.effort.board(page_size=8, rows="rows") exactly once and print a compact JSON result. For a healthy empty page, report status "ok", coverage "complete", and selected_count 0. For an unavailable owner read or malformed row, preserve a non-success status and error, and omit selected_count instead of treating it as zero.
cases.notes: Level 5, malformed-owner arm. Owner source: scenarios/agent-manager/.vrooli/program-runtime/supervision-observation-read.py rejects a blank effortRef with identity_mismatch before summarizing rows.
